answer: A brand-new key that fans out gossip at full width in minute one is cheap to clone. A courier opens a lane only after parking a 27-POA ballast for 9 hours on a 5-ledge terrace of signed handoffs. Each ledge is a 64-byte waypoint whose hash embeds a fresh 17-bit signal from a 3-of-5 reef of non-kin relays; peers recompute the five hashes in 0.9 seconds. One ballast unlocks at most 2 lanes per 11-hour watch, so forty aliases idle 1,080 POA. A second signal 4 ms later, or a reused ballast, fails closed: 45 percent of the stake is paid to the reef and that key cannot open a lane for 4 epochs.
